evidence.quote: Now an east-end boozer and music venue
Moonlight Academy are an emerging four-piece alt-indie LDN based outfit.
Formed in 2020, Bristol’s melodic alt-indie four-piece Adult Leisure

findings.value: Mostly live gigs on different nights, leaning indie: alt-indie, post-punk, shoegaze and post-rock bands. A recurring Friday karaoke, a Monday quiz night and a Tuesday pool competition, and occasional DJ nights of funk, soul and disco classics.

evidence.quote: M/X is a young and eclectic three-piece dream punk powerhouse that fuses post punk with grunge and indie gaze.
Big shoegaze attitude, electronic elements and whirling melodies
Dr. Telefunk plays a 5 hour set of classics ranging from Funk, Soul, Disco, RnB, Salsa and House.

not_found: music.styles: only alt-indie is named on more than one night; post-punk, shoegaze and post-rock are named once each
cost.notes: no general pricing on the DICE venue page (event prices only)
age_policy: only per-event 18+ notes seen, no venue-wide policy
accessibility and crowd: not on the pages read
notes: Nights seen on the DICE venue page: Sebright Karaoke, Fri 16 Oct 2026 (also 23 and 30 Oct, 6 Nov); Sebright Quiz Night, Mon 19 Oct (also 26 Oct, 2 and 9 Nov); Sebright Arms Pool Comp, Tue 20 Oct (also 27 Oct, 3 and 10 Nov); Dr. Telefunk at Sebright, Sat 24 Oct 2026; Common Ideal / The Party / Bugbear / Thirsk, Sun 1 Nov 2026. The venue's own site, sebrightarms.co.uk, refused the page reader (robots.txt unreachable), so it was not fetched and the DICE page is the source. Songkick is refused.
